name: koya_gooface
desc: Keep the same melted, dripping paint body, size and position, the legs still merged into the puddle. The head is thrown back and tilted up toward the sky, still unformed: there are no eyes yet, only a dog muzzle with a nose has formed, with half-formed pointed ears and spiky hair drooping from the head, and the mouth hangs wide open like a dark gaping hole, with thick sticky strings of paint stretching between the upper and lower jaw and dripping down the chin and neck, gooey and gross. Same colors, cream swirls, outline and pixel art style.
